public_rationale: The AlphaGeometry Nature paper calls the system neuro-symbolic: a neural language model guides a symbolic deduction engine. It solved 25 of 30 olympiad problems, against 10 for the previous best method. AlphaGeometry2 keeps that design, with a Gemini-based language model and an improved symbolic engine, and solves 84% of IMO geometry problems. AlphaProof is a learned agent that finds proofs in the Lean formal language, and it reached silver-medal level at IMO 2024. All three combine neural learning with symbolic or formal reasoning and had strong results. 'Flagship' is a fair description of their prominence, but it is not scored.
limitations: The neuro-symbolic label for AlphaProof is an interpretation; its paper does not use the term.
'Flagship' is evaluative and not independently testable.
